entries.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
entries.description: Lets Brain A post alerts and recommendations to Slack.
howToGet: At api.slack.com/apps, create an app, add the chat:write scope, install it, and copy the Bot User OAuth Token.

entries.name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
entries.description: Verifies requests Slack sends to this instance.
howToGet: At api.slack.com/apps, open the app > Basic Information > App Credentials, and copy the Signing Secret.
